speaker: dvm
text: Hi there. So this is Pepper's recheck for the ear infection. How has she been doing?

speaker: client
text: Much better. She stopped shaking her head after about four days, and we finished all the drops yesterday.

speaker: dvm
text: Great. Let me take a look. Her weight today is twelve point six kilos, the same as last time. Temperature is thirty-eight point five.

speaker: dvm
text: The left ear canal looks clean now. No redness, no discharge, and she isn't painful when I handle it.

speaker: client
text: That's a relief. Do we need to keep cleaning it?

speaker: dvm
text: Yes, clean both ears once a week with the ear cleaner, especially after swimming. The otitis has resolved, so no more medication for now.

speaker: dvm
text: If the head shaking comes back, call us and we'll have a look sooner. Otherwise we'll see her at her annual exam in March.
